in_marathi.name: Pandu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pandu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Pandu was the eldest of the two sons of King Vyas and Queen Madri. He was a just and powerful king who was cursed to die if he saw his wife. Despite this, he led an army to war and was killed when he saw his wife in disguise. Before dying, he asked his brother Vidura to take care of his sons, Yudhishthira and Bhima.
